description: Students used to train the categorization model, one row per student. Column keys are the headers after normalize_headers.
label: category

new_students.description: Students who signed up after the training set was built. They have every column except the label, which the model predicts, plus the time they signed up. Only the ones who signed up after the last student already in are added.

created_at.description: When the student signed up, in ISO 8601. Stored in UTC; a time without an offset is read as UTC.

color.description: Favorite color. The order of allowed is the one-hot encoding order.

location.description: City where the student lives. The order of allowed is the one-hot encoding order.

category.description: Label the model predicts. The order of allowed is the one-hot encoding order.
